title: Bạn có thể kiểm tra camera an ninh được không?
englishTitle: Can you check the security camera?
pronunciation: Ban co the kiem tra camera an ninh duoc khong
summary: For asking staff to review camera footage after a lost item, wrong bag, room issue, or pickup confusion.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use this at a desk with the time, place, and item visible. The more exact the moment, the easier the ask.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the receipt, room number, ride screen, or photo first. Then ask for the camera check in one calm sentence.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể kiểm tra camera an ninh được không?
phrases.english: Can you check the security camera?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the kiem tra camera an ninh duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; kiểm tra means check; camera an ninh means security camera; được không softens the request.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể kiểm tra camera an ninh được không?
breakdown.english: Can you check the security camera?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Lost, left-something, and help cards cover the story you may need before staff can look.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotels, shops, stations, cafes, apartment lobbies, and parking areas where a camera may cover the spot.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Staff may need a manager, time range, or location. Keep the detail short and avoid turning it into a long accusation.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to need-help, call-hotel, manager, charged-twice, or file-report cards if the desk asks for the next step.
